posts.subject: Knife Application by me 2.0
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello! the is my second knife application cause I'm still up for it and fixed alot of the problems from last time.


1) What´s your real name and ingame name?
My real name is Hampus and most know me as "WHAT" ingame


2) How old are you and where are you from?
I am 16 years old and I'm from Sweden


3) Do you think you meet the requirements?
I think so very much yes. I knowed the rules long enough and I been playing on the server for a while now and I'm a nice person if you are nice back but I can stay calm if someone is a bit mad or anything like that.


4) Why do you want to be a admin on one of the dream servers?
Well most of all cause this community is really nice and I really wanna keep it that way but there are alot of trolls and other annyoing people that come to the server and think it's so fun to just ruin it for everyone. We have really nice and good admin that help with this sort of things but there are not always online or available when I'm playing and I would really help more out with this community and really feel apart of it.


5) How long have to been playing on the server?
I have been on the server a little over 12000 min (200 hours)


6) Do you think you are mature even for your age?
Yes I really do, I can be silly sometimes but who isn't. I swear but nothing really offensive or nothing really anyone can get offended by. But I am very mature even for my age and you can really talk to me if you want to. I can tell the diffrent between right and wrong and i would never kick or ban a person before warning them. And not even after that cause that would proberly lead to a slay but it really depends on the situation. Am not easily offended and would not ban/kick/slay someone out of rage or being annoyed, then I'll just go to spectaor mode and calm down for a bit or leave the server in worst case.


7) Have you been any kind of admin before or had experience before?
I been a moderator on a bhop server before until it got closed for reasons I still don't know until this day. I know how to act when someone is mad, annoyed, or anything negetive. Stay calm and try to reason with them, if they don't care well that't that then.


[8)] What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
Well that's ofcourse playing video games and that's everything from FPS to adventures but not any car games just race games. I like swimming alot and I work out on the mornings and stuff. I trying to hangout with my best friends so much I can. I like watching movies and cartoons like Family guy, Rick and morty, South Park and The Simpsons.


9) When do you play or are you online?


Monday-Friday 15.:00-23:00 (Depends on if i end my last class a bit early then I'm home before 15:00 with 30 min at max
Saturday-Sunday 10:00-0:00 (If I'm not with friends or doing something else but proberly not)


(I'll have to add that every 2 weeks am at school, other 2 weeks I work and so on, and I really haven't got my real times yet but I will give an update as fast as I can when I get them.


10) If player 1 insult player 2 in anyway, how would you deal with that?
If I don't know if there are friends, if they are i would allow it but only if they keep it civil. If they aren't then I would ask him/her nicely to don't insualt other players. If player 1 continues after he/she will be muted and if he/she continues in chat I would gag him/her. If he/she does the leave and rejoin and keep insualting he will receive a "cooldown/ban" on 30 minutes. If user 1 have multiple he will not get a warning cause he/she already knows what the rules are. If it's a new player and this continues on the same person I'll have to talk in private with both of them and ask other players that have been on the server at the same time. If the person attack more than 1 person I'll have a talk to him/her and some others that him/she attacked and ask for a reason and see if we can fix this, if not someone is getting a ban or in really worst cases it will be more admins and higher rank admins involved.


11) Strenghts
Very mature for my age
Not easliy offended
Alot more online on ts3 and the forum (got new pc recently so idk if my time on ts3 got removed but I think so but I have more hours than i should have, and I read the forum everyday now and all new threads)
I understand if you are in a diffrent mood than happy
Easy to talk to
Pretty strong english speaking
Show respect for any type of person
Easliy recognize other languages
12) Weaknesses
My english writing grammer is not 10/10 but it's understandable
I swear but it happens and it's not really offensive and most of it is to my friends and it's mostly blank
This is a german community before an english and I don't know much german but [google]
13) closing remark
Thank you so much whoever reads this and supports me in any way. And I wanna thank all the players who would think I would be a nice and good admin and thank you so much for doing a amazing job to all Admins and I hope I get to talk to more of the admins on this community. I hope I'll see you on the knifer server where I am most on and please if you see me, say "HI!" that would make me very happy even if i don't know you. Thanks again everyone that is part of dream community and I hope this application is better than the last one! [dgrün*]
This is a very beautiful Application. [respekt*]

Nice to see that you're applying again Hampus, hope you're doing well.


In my opinion, you are mature and you definitely have the determination to become a good admin - you are generally very caring when not trying to liven up the servers which suggests to me that you can handle problems very well. Leading on from that, you are very lively when on the servers, often interacting with the players and creating an cool, calm, fun atmosphere.


However, knowing you, you are somewhat easy to anger, as a joke or not. Thus, I hope you are able to contain this harmless anger when dealing with situations and acting mature in serious situations. Another downward spiral that this can cause is that you could possibly carelessly do a bit too harsh and unfair punishments - I'd think, especially if the victim was you or someone close.


My question to you is, are you able to take serious situations, seirously? Also, say a friend of yours was to become the victim of a rule-breaker, how would you treat the situation?


In conclusion, my vote is NEUTRAL for now.


Good luck in your application,
~Doo Doo
